messages:
Shilpa: quick q — can we expose a pager/notify mapping in the console so product teams can map SLO thresholds to notification tiers? e.g. breach >99.5% = slack/email only, breach >99% for 5m = pager to oncall.
Kevin: we discussed this a bit last week. major concern is fanout — if multiple teams subscribe to same route we end up paging everyone. need team-scoped routing and mute windows. :thinking_face:
Alex: agreed on scoping. also want 'sustained breach' config (window + percent of buckets) rather than instant triggers. default windows: 1m/5m/30m selectable.
Maria: telemetry note — notification payload should include route, model version, rollout tag, and a short fingerprint so routing rules can dedupe alerts. otherwise multiple alerts look different and cause duplicate pages.
oncall-bot: IncidentPolicyBot: default escalation -> rotation:runtime-oncall, notify: #runtime-alerts, snooze-window: 0m
Emma: from UX side we should show a preview modal: "If this SLO triggers, who gets paged?" and a small estimate of notifications generated per month (based on historical breach frequency). that helps teams tune thresholds.
Shilpa: proposal: add an "urgency matrix" UI that maps SLO breach severity + window -> action (none/email/slack/pager) + escalation policy. sample shape: ```{\n  "severity": "critical",\n  "breach_window": "5m",\n  "condition": ">=3/5 buckets",\n  "action": "pager",\n  "escalation": "oncall/runtime"\n}```
Kevin: edge case: rollouts cause transient blips. add a rollout tag filter so alerts from tests/canary can auto-snooze for X minutes. also allow a "min impact" threshold (e.g., only page if affected_traffic_pct >= 1%).
Alex: also prefer route-level overrides. infra teams should be able to pin 'no-page' for low-priority routes. and add a global safety to never page during maintenance windows.
Maria: I'll take a quick RFC with telemetry props and example webhook payload for routing rules. will include dedupe key and sample rules for per-team routing.
Shilpa: awesome — can you include a mock of the preview modal and a compact table of defaults? (5m critical -> page, 30m high -> slack/email).
Emma: will draft the UX mock tomorrow. I'll add a small toggle: "suppress pages during rollout tags" and a tooltip explaining why.
Kevin: sounds good. next steps: Maria write RFC, Emma mock, Alex add a design doc for per-route override API, Shilpa will put this on the eng-platform backlog. :thumbsup:
Shilpa: thanks all — please add any blockers here. planning to demo at next crew sync if RFC lands this week.
